Name: ASSET_GEOMETORY_PARAM_ST
Description: Per-model asset (AEG) settings. The row ID is the asset model number (AEG001_234 uses row 1234). Covers behaviour type, collision, destruction, burning, pickup, sounds, effects, navmesh and ray tracing.

Fields.Name: Sound Bank ID
Fields.Description: Sound bank ID (-1: no bank, other: bank with specified ID)

Fields.Name: Break SE ID
Fields.Description: Sound played when the asset breaks (9-digit SE ID). -1: generated from the asset ID.

Fields.Name: Draw Param Reference ID
Fields.Description: PartsDrawParam row used to draw the asset.

Fields.Name: Hit Create Type
Fields.Description: Sets the hit build type for static assets. Ignored for dynamic assets.

Fields.Name: Asset Behavior Type
Fields.Description: Dynamic: all asset features are available. Static: a light asset with limited features, handled like old-style map parts. Partial Static: a partly breakable asset.

Fields.Name: Collision Detection Type
Fields.Description: Collision detection type. You can set what the asset will hit.

Fields.Name: Rain Blocking Type
Fields.Description: How the asset blocks rain. Near: updates the near-range map used to block rain particle effects. Far: updates the far-range map used to block the wet look (heavy load).

Fields.Name: HP
Fields.Description: Durability before the asset breaks. -1: indestructible.

Fields.Name: Defence
Fields.Description: Attacks with an attack power at or below this value deal no damage to the asset.

Fields.Name: Destruction Stop Time
Fields.Description: Time after breaking before the debris rigid bodies are forcibly stopped. 0: never forcibly stopped.

Fields.Name: Destruction Particle: ID
Fields.Description: Particle effect played when the asset breaks. -1: default (810030).

Fields.Name: Destruction Particle: Dummy Polygon ID
Fields.Description: Dummy poly where the break particle effect plays. -1: from the asset's centre; -2: at the placement position.

Fields.Name: Landing Destruction Particle: ID
Fields.Description: Identifier of the material-dependent particle effect played when the broken asset first lands. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Destruction Bullet Behavior ID
Fields.Description: BehaviorParam row of the bullet fired when the asset breaks. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Destruction Bullet Dummy Poly ID
Fields.Description: Dummy poly the break bullet is fired from. -1: the placement position.

Fields.Name: Hidden Debris - Wait Time
Fields.Description: Time after breaking before the debris starts to be hidden. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Hidden Debris - Time to Hide
Fields.Description: Time taken to hide the debris. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Destruction AI Sound ID
Fields.Description: AiSoundParam row emitted when the asset breaks.

Fields.Name: Anim Break ID Max
Fields.Description: Highest animated break ID: the asset's animated break IDs run from 0 to this value.

Fields.Name: Update Group Mask Limit Frame Number
Fields.Description: Number of frames for group mask switching time

Fields.Name: Is Destroyed on Player Collision
Fields.Description: If ON, the asset breaks when the player touches it.

Fields.Name: Is Destroyed on Enemy Collision
Fields.Description: If ON, the asset breaks when an enemy touches it.

Fields.Name: Is Destroyed by Riding
Fields.Description: If ON, the asset breaks when a character stands on it.

Fields.Name: Unbreakable on First Appearance
Fields.Description: If ON, the asset is not broken by the player's initial appearance in the map.

Fields.Name: Is Animated Destruction
Fields.Description: OFF: physics destruction. ON: animated destruction (the asset plays a break animation).

Fields.Name: Set Update Frequency to HiActive during Animation
Fields.Description: If ON, the asset alone is updated at HiActive frequency while an animation plays.

Fields.Name: Set Update Frequency to HiActive
Fields.Description: If ON, the asset is always updated at HiActive frequency.

Fields.Name: Synchronise Destruction
Fields.Description: If ON, the asset's destruction is synchronised.

Fields.Name: Blocks Damage
Fields.Description: If ON, damage the asset receives does not pass through to the other side. OFF: it passes through.

Fields.Name: Deflects Attacks
Fields.Description: If ON, attacks that hit the asset are deflected.

Fields.Name: Hit by Penetrating Bullets
Fields.Description: If ON, penetrating bullets hit the asset. OFF: they don't hit it.

Fields.Name: Is Ladder
Fields.Description: If ON, the asset is a ladder.

Fields.Name: Is Moving Object
Fields.Description: If ON, the asset is a moving object. Used to branch movement handling in multiplayer.

Fields.Name: Is Inside Group Hit
Fields.Description: If ON, collision parts within the asset interfere with each other.

Fields.Name: Is Paused during Cutscene
Fields.Description: If ON, the asset's animation stops while a cutscene plays.

Fields.Name: Is Flammable
Fields.Description: If ON, the asset can burn.

Fields.Name: Pre-destruction Navmesh Flag
Fields.Description: Navigation mesh flag set from assets before destruction

Fields.Name: Burn Bullet Interval
Fields.Description: Interval between the bullets fired to spread fire. In frames.

Fields.Name: Camera Distance to Update Cloth
Fields.Description: Camera distance within which the asset's Havok cloth is updated. In metres. 0: always updated.

Fields.Name: Runtime-Created Asset Lifetime
Fields.Description: Time after creation before a runtime-created asset disappears. In seconds. 0: never disappears.

Fields.Name: Contact SE ID
Fields.Description: Sound played when the local player you control touches the asset. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Runtime-Created Asset Fade Out Time
Fields.Description: Fade-out time when a runtime-created asset disappears after its lifetime. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Wind Effect Rate - Before Destruction
Fields.Description: Wind coefficient (before destruction)

Fields.Name: Wind Effect Rate - After Destruction
Fields.Description: Wind coefficient (after destruction)

Fields.Name: Wind Effect Type - Before Destruction
Fields.Description: Wind effect type (before destruction)

Fields.Name: Wind Effect Type - After Destruction
Fields.Description: Wind effect type (after destruction)

Fields.Name: Override Material ID
Fields.Description: Overrides the asset's material ID. -1: use the model's material ID; 0 or more: material ID to use. On a ladder the material ID only comes from this setting.

Fields.Name: Automatic Generation Height Offset
Fields.Description: When the asset is generated automatically on the map, how far above the raycast hit point it floats. In metres.

Fields.Name: Burn Time
Fields.Description: Burning time. In seconds. 0: burns indefinitely.

Fields.Name: Burn Destroy Rate
Fields.Description: Burn progress threshold at which the asset switches to its broken state.

Fields.Name: Burn Particle: ID [0]
Fields.Description: Particle effect 0 played while burning. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Burn Particle: ID [1]
Fields.Description: Particle effect 1 played while burning. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Burn Particle: ID [2]
Fields.Description: Particle effect 2 played while burning. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Burn Particle: ID [3]
Fields.Description: Particle effect 3 played while burning. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Burn Particle: Minimum Delay Time [0]
Fields.Description: Minimum delay before burn particle effect 0 starts; the delay is random between the minimum and maximum. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Burn Particle: Minimum Delay Time [1]
Fields.Description: Minimum delay before burn particle effect 1 starts; the delay is random between the minimum and maximum. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Burn Particle: Minimum Delay Time [2]
Fields.Description: Minimum delay before burn particle effect 2 starts; the delay is random between the minimum and maximum. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Burn Particle: Minimum Delay Time [3]
Fields.Description: Minimum delay before burn particle effect 3 starts; the delay is random between the minimum and maximum. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Burn Particle: Maximum Delay Time [0]
Fields.Description: Maximum delay before burn particle effect 0 starts; the delay is random between the minimum and maximum. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Burn Particle: Maximum Delay Time [1]
Fields.Description: Maximum delay before burn particle effect 1 starts; the delay is random between the minimum and maximum. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Burn Particle: Maximum Delay Time [2]
Fields.Description: Maximum delay before burn particle effect 2 starts; the delay is random between the minimum and maximum. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Burn Particle: Maximum Delay Time [3]
Fields.Description: Maximum delay before burn particle effect 3 starts; the delay is random between the minimum and maximum. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Burn Bullet Behavior ID [0]
Fields.Description: BehaviorParam row of bullet 0 fired while burning. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Burn Bullet Behavior ID [1]
Fields.Description: BehaviorParam row of bullet 1 fired while burning. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Burn Bullet Behavior ID [2]
Fields.Description: BehaviorParam row of bullet 2 fired while burning. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Burn Bullet Behavior ID [3]
Fields.Description: BehaviorParam row of bullet 3 fired while burning. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Burn Bullet Delay Time
Fields.Description: Delay before the bullets that spread fire start. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Paint Decal Target Texture Size
Fields.Description: Texture size for paint decals on the asset. 0: paint decals disabled. Only powers of 2 from 2 to 2048 are valid.

Fields.Name: Post-destruction Navmesh Flag
Fields.Description: Navmesh flag set from the asset after it breaks.

Fields.Name: Auto-Generate Cover Area
Fields.Description: If ON, a cover area is generated automatically from the navmesh data around the asset.

Fields.Name: Cast Shadow
Fields.Description: If ON, the asset casts a shadow.

Fields.Name: Near Camera Behavior Type
Fields.Description: Drawing settings when approaching the camera.

Fields.Name: Penetration Resistance
Fields.Description: A bullet penetrates the asset if its object penetration value in the bullet param is greater than this value.

Fields.Name: Rigid Body Param ID
Fields.Description: RigidBodyParam row used for the asset's rigid body.

Fields.Name: Destruction Strength
Fields.Description: Strength to send rigid bodies flying during physical destruction

Fields.Name: Destruction Position
Fields.Description: Base point from which rigid bodies are sent flying during physics destruction.

Fields.Name: Is Rotational Destruction
Fields.Description: If ON, the game controls the rotation of the pieces when the asset breaks.

Fields.Name: Destroy on Map Collision
Fields.Description: If ON, the asset breaks when it touches the map.

Fields.Name: 3D Mini-map Display Type
Fields.Description: Display settings on 3D minimap

Fields.Name: Destruction Rotation Strength
Fields.Description: Strength to rotate a rigid body during physical destruction

Fields.Name: Material affects Physical Behavior
Fields.Description: If ON, the material affects the asset's physical behaviour.

Fields.Name: Auto Draw Group: Backface Check
Fields.Description: Back-face check setting for the automatic draw group.

Fields.Name: Auto Draw Group: Depth Write
Fields.Description: Occlusion setting for the automatic draw group.

Fields.Name: Breaks Only on Contact
Fields.Description: If ON, the asset can only be broken by contact destruction.

Fields.Name: Can Enter Collision before Destruction
Fields.Description: If ON, characters can sink into the asset's collision before it breaks. For breakable models that may be overlapped, such as trees.

Fields.Name: Disable Deferred Decals
Fields.Description: If ON, deferred decals are disabled on the asset.

Fields.Name: Exclude from Ray Tracing
Fields.Description: If ON, the asset is excluded from ray tracing. Use it when the asset causes problems in ray tracing, such as casting a huge shadow.

Fields.Name: Disable Depth Prepass
Fields.Description: If ON, the depth prepass is disabled for the asset. Set it for small, thin assets placed in large numbers, such as trees and utility poles, where the depth prepass does not work well.

Fields.Name: Force Motion Blur
Fields.Description: If ON, motion blur is forced on. Motion blur is normally disabled when no animation or rigid body weight is set; use this for assets attached to moving assets, such as the parts of an elevator.

Fields.Name: Destruction Collision Speed
Fields.Description: Speed a character must reach to break the asset by contact. In km/h.

Fields.Name: Destroyed Item Lot Param ID
Fields.Description: Item lot rolled when the asset breaks. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Pickup Action Button Param ID
Fields.Description: Action button shown for collecting the asset. -1: collection disabled.

Fields.Name: Pickup Item Lot Param ID
Fields.Description: Item lot rolled when the asset is collected. -1: collection disabled.

Fields.Name: Pickup: Collected Asset Animation ID
Fields.Description: Animation the asset plays once it has been collected.

Fields.Name: Auto Draw Group: Pass Pixel Number
Fields.Description: Automatic drawing group: pass pixels (set between 0.0 and 1.0 to enlarge when shooting)

Fields.Name: Is Affected by Wave Simulation
Fields.Description: If ON, the asset is affected by the Havok wave simulation before it breaks.

Fields.Name: Is Affected by Wave Simulation (Destroyed)
Fields.Description: If ON, the asset is affected by the Havok wave simulation after it breaks.

Fields.Name: Debug: Enable Allowable Height Check
Fields.Description: Debug only. Enables the allowable ground height check for the asset.

Fields.Name: Raytracing Culling Mode
Fields.Description: Culling mode applied when drawing raytracing. If it is set to 'Auto', it will be the default value set in the program.

Fields.Name: Buoyancy Lost Timer Delay
Fields.Description: Time before the asset starts to lose buoyancy, before it breaks. In seconds. -1: never loses buoyancy.

Fields.Name: Buoyancy Lost Timer Delay (Destroyed)
Fields.Description: Time before the asset starts to lose buoyancy, after it breaks. In seconds. -1: never loses buoyancy.

Fields.Name: Buoyancy Lost Timer
Fields.Description: Time taken to lose buoyancy, before the asset breaks. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Buoyancy Lost Timer (Destroyed)
Fields.Description: Time taken to lose buoyancy, after the asset breaks. In seconds.

Fields.Name: SpEffect for Characters inside Collision
Fields.Description: SpEffect applied to characters inside the asset's collision.

Fields.Name: Resident Sound: ID
Fields.Description: Sound kept resident on the asset (9-digit ID). -1: none.

Fields.Name: Resident Sound: Dummy Polygon ID
Fields.Description: Dummy poly the resident sound is attached to. -1: the placement position.

Fields.Name: Resident Sound: Effective Distance
Fields.Description: Distance within which the resident sound is active. In metres. 0 or less: always active.

Fields.Name: Debug: Allowable Ground Height (Min)
Fields.Description: Debug only. Minimum allowable ground height. In metres. Must be smaller than the maximum.

Fields.Name: Debug: Allowable Ground Height (Max)
Fields.Description: Debug only. Maximum allowable ground height. In metres. Must be greater than the minimum.

Fields.Name: Destruction Sound: Dummy Polygon ID
Fields.Description: Dummy poly where the break sound plays. -1: the placement position.

Fields.Name: Destruction Particle: Offset X
Fields.Description: X offset of the break particle effect from its dummy poly (Destruction Particle: Dummy Polygon ID).

Fields.Name: Destruction Particle: Offset Y
Fields.Description: Y offset of the break particle effect from its dummy poly (Destruction Particle: Dummy Polygon ID).

Fields.Name: Destruction Particle: Offset Z
Fields.Description: Z offset of the break particle effect from its dummy poly (Destruction Particle: Dummy Polygon ID).

Fields.Name: Particle: Shape
Fields.Description: Shape of the particles. 0: sphere, 1: box.

Fields.Name: Particle: Size
Fields.Description: Size of the particles. In metres.

Fields.Name: Particle: Friction Coefficient
Fields.Description: Friction coefficient of the particles.

Fields.Name: Particle: Restitution Coefficient
Fields.Description: Restitution (bounce) coefficient of the particles.

Fields.Name: Particle: Minimum Speed when Generated
Fields.Description: Minimum speed of the particles when they are generated. In km/h.

Fields.Name: Particle: Maximum Speed when Generated
Fields.Description: Maximum speed of the particles when they are generated. In km/h.

Fields.Name: Particle: Minimum Rotation Speed
Fields.Description: Minimum rotation speed of the particles.

Fields.Name: Particle: Maximum Rotation Speed
Fields.Description: Maximum rotation speed of the particles.

Fields.Name: Particle: Left Movement Direction Angle
Fields.Description: Angle range of the particles' movement direction to the left.

Fields.Name: Particle: Right Movement Direction Angle
Fields.Description: Angle range of the particles' movement direction to the right.

Fields.Name: Particle: Upward Movement Direction Angle
Fields.Description: Angle range of the particles' movement direction upwards.

Fields.Name: Particle: Downward Movement Direction Angle
Fields.Description: Angle range of the particles' movement direction downwards.

Fields.Name: Destruction: Decal ID
Fields.Description: Decal created when the asset breaks. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Destruction: Decal Dummy Polygon ID
Fields.Description: Dummy poly where the break decal is created. -1: from the asset's centre; -2: at the placement position.

Fields.Name: Is Material Set in Navmesh upon Asset Destruction
Fields.Description: If ON, the navmesh is given the material used for breakable assets.

Fields.Name: Is Important Grid for World Slide
Fields.Description: If ON, the asset is registered in the important grid for world slide (background shift).

Fields.Name: Is Huge Grid for World Slide
Fields.Description: If ON, the asset is registered in the huge grid for world slide (background shift).

Fields.Name: Disabled in Mining Ship Mission
Fields.Description: If ON, the asset is disabled in the mining ship mission.

Fields.Name: No Checkpoint Save
Fields.Description: If ON, the asset is not included in checkpoint saves.

Fields.Name: Check for Cover when Hit
Fields.Description: If ON, a cover check is made when the asset is hit. Only for assets that pass damage on to another target.
